name: fixture-kit
description: Sanitized Antigravity plugin manifest sample. Verified on the remote 1.5.9 machine: agy plugin install copies the directory to ~/.gemini/config/plugins/<name>/ and agy plugin list --json reports name/enabled/version/source/path plus the skills[], agents[], rules[], mcpServers[] and hooks[] resource names. plugin.json parses as JSONC; unknown top-level fields are silently dropped by the loader.
